mapper.insert: insert into hys_wallet_txn (member_id, txn_type, amount, fee, balance_after, counterparty_id, biz_key, remark, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{txnType}, #{amount}, #{fee}, #{balanceAfter}, #{counterpartyId}, #{bizKey}, #{remark}, now())
mapper.select: select txn_id, member_id, txn_type, amount, fee, balance_after, counterparty_id, biz_key, remark, create_time from hys_wallet_txn where biz_key = #{bizKey}
select count(1) from hys_wallet_txn where member_id = #{memberId} and txn_type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' and create_time >= #{start}
